newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose sharply to 1.896 billion yuan from 724 million yuan on Wednesday with the one-day contract the most actively traded.
Traders said trading was more active than Wednesday as both banks and short-term financial centres increased trading volume.
Traders said rumours about an impending cut in bank reserve ratios had made trading very dull on Wednesday.
And on Thursday, some traders said an imminent cut was not possible, which helped to boost market sentiment and activate the trading.
But falls on the domestic A share markets somehow had a slight negative impact on the the interbank market, other traders said.
"The falls in A shares reduced fund demand by some non-banking financial institutions including securities houses and kept them on the sidelines of the interbank market," said one trader.
Traders said the interbank rates were likely to move marginally in the next few days.
